gap_details.2011-2012: UNOBSERVABLE: residents page kept the 2010-11 list in every capture Nov 2011-Jun 2012; nothing Jul 2012-May 2013. Phase 2: CC-MAIN-2012 retried and SUCCEEDED (13 URLs under edu,mssm)/departments-and-institutes/neurosurgery, Feb/May 2012; no residents page; the only news page is about June 2011 awards). Wayback gap audit Jun 2011-Dec 2012 over www.mssm.edu dept, /gme, mountsinai.org: no other roster. PubMed affiliation mining 2011-13: no unlisted resident. Reconstructed 14 bracketed residents. Jannapureddy is the only open question (exit Jul 2011-May 2013).

gap_details.2014-2015: UNOBSERVABLE: the page kept the 2013-14 list through Aug 2015 (Wayback + Common Crawl); 2015-09 is 2015-16. All 7 classes are complete at 2 on both sides.
gap_details.2016-2017..2020-2021: Roster embedded in program main page; Wayback 2016-11-15, 2017-10-12, 2018-08-01, 2019-10-20, 2020-10-26. 'Chief Resident' = PGY-7 except Rothrock 2019-20 (PGY-6 by class).

departures.name: Madhu Jannapureddy
departures.note: 2008 entrant. Absent 2012-13 on, not an alumna; left Jul 2011-May 2013 (end_year 2012 estimated). No later trace in PubMed/OpenAlex; NPI last updated 2009. Outcome unknown.

departures.name: Noah Nichols
departures.note: Listed 14 Jan 2025, gone 12 Feb 2025. The NPPES 'switch' is not evidence (his NPI is the 2021 student record). Manuscripts submitted to Oct 2025 still give Mount Sinai Neurosurgery -> possible leave. Outcome unknown.

departures.name: Chi Le
departures.note: Listed 21 Feb 2025; absent Feb 2026, Jun 2026 and live. Manuscripts submitted Aug 2025 still give Mount Sinai Neurosurgery -> possible research leave. Outcome unknown.

joiners.name: Hekmat Zarzour
joiners.note: Transfer in from SLU (program 60): SLU housestaff Feb 2013, SLU chief 2011-12 (Jefferson bio). Joined at a PGY-4 label, PGY-7 in 2015-16, graduated 2016. The labels don't fit one entry year because his SLU training was credited.

joiners.name: Santiago Gomez Paz
joiners.note: Not a neurosurgery transfer: research fellow at Univ of Utah neurosurgery 2024-25 (PubMed), then probably a 2025-26 prelim PGY-1 at Mount Sinai (Feb 2026 paper affiliation). Joined at PGY-2.

adjudication_summary.note: The 3 LEFT are Jannapureddy, Nichols and Le (all outcome unknown). Haridas artefact cleared with a 2011 alumni row. No SWITCHED SPECIALTY: the Nichols NPI call was dropped.

terminal_pgy_overrides.Hekmat Zarzour: transfer in 2013, graduated 2016 at a PGY-7 label

terminal_pgy_note: The program moved from 6 to 7 years in the 2006-07 entry classes: 2006 entrants Biro, George, De Los Reyes finished in 2012 at PGY-6, Binello (2006) took 7 years (2013). 2007 entrants: Gologorsky finished at PGY-6 (2013), Motivala and Panov at PGY-7 (2014). 2008 on: 7 years. The mismatches in phase 1 were a stale PGY label (De Los Reyes) plus these individual track differences.
